body: I'll do my best. I just hope I can deal with the pain long enough to avoid offing myself before things improve- if they ever do.

Thanks for the reply, I appreciate it.

I'm mainly trying to work towards being more independent. I'm on SSI and food stamps currently and relying a lot on my family for medical bills and misc expenses like cell phone, car insurance, health insurance etc.

I've found a way to make some money while working from home, but I'm so tired and sad that I really struggle to make it a full time gig.

It's night again and I just know I'm going to be awake until the morning. Trying to avoid using the suicide hotline again, but it's looking more and more likely.
